Here's a look at how the opening bitcoin price has changed versus last week, month, and year:
Both bitcoin and ethereum prices opened again near 8-month highs this morning, as President Trump prepares to host Chinese President Xi Jinping in Washington this week.
"The BTC breakout is credible," Fundstrat head of digital assets Sean Farrell told Yahoo Finance on Monday.
"I think the crypto winter is over, although that does not necessarily mean the path higher will be linear."
Bitcoin, ethereum, and other cryptocurrencies are rapidly evolving.

Bitcoin's price has swung sharply in recent months.
Here's how to buy and store bitcoin as safely as possible.

The markets are beginning to pick up with capital inflowing into the sector.
For investors entering now, the key question isn’t whether to buy crypto; it’s which assets match your time horizon and risk appetite.
September 2026 has seen an impressive crypto rally with Bitcoin leading the charge.
Bitcoin has shot from $60,000 to $85,000 in just two weeks.

Bitcoin has plenty of momentum, is leading the crypto charge, and we are seeing Bitcoin ETF inflows in the positive, leading investors to expect Bitcoin still has some room to run and possibly reclaim the coveted $100,000 price point.
XRP has one of the strongest and most loyal fan bases in all of crypto, and with the September 2026, the “XRP Army” is in full force, propelling the asset over 10% in just 7 days.
As memecoins continue to outperform many other crypto projects, Dogecoin is the most recognized “blue chip” memecoin that ends up taking most of the liquidity.
If you want to invest in established crypto projects (a.k.a. dino coins ), look at their past price charts and how they handled tough periods, such as the 2022–2023 crypto winter.
Cardano has chosen a different route than the path followed by Ethereum and Solana.
Cardano is a research-focused blockchain led by a highly technical team that prioritizes compliance and technological accuracy over speed and marketing.
This is evident in Cardano’s 100% uptime and interest expressed by governments and academic institutions.
There’s no one “best” crypto for a $1,000 investment.
Conservative investors consider Bitcoin or Ethereum as core long‑term holdings, while growth-oriented investors prefer smaller‑cap tokens for their upside potential despite the higher risk.
Pectra (live since May 2026) already increased validator staking limits and improved wallet UX.
The Glamsterdam fork , targeting mid-2026, is designed to push transaction capacity well beyond its current ceiling.
ETH staking yields currently sit around 3–4% annually, which adds a carry component most blue chips can’t offer.
BNB’s investment case rests on two things: Binance’s continued market share dominance (still the largest CEX by volume), and BNB Chain’s growing ecosystem beyond the exchange.

Active in the industry since 2023, she first became fascinated...
Ethereum is a consistent market leader and the leading layer 1, forming the foundation of DeFi, DePin, and much of the crypto infrastructure.
BNB Chain’s 2026 upgrades focus on speed, smoother trading during traffic spikes, and better reliability.

For 2026, many analysts point to Bitcoin for its liquidity and macro hedge appeal, but Ethereum gets cited more often as having the most overall potential due to network activity, developer ecosystem, smart contract dominance, and upcoming upgrades.
The best long-term crypto assets represent large markets with millions of users and high trading volumes.
